description: Play UNO in Minecraft - a Fabric 1.21.11 port of Zbx1425/minopp (MIT)

releases.notes:
A Fabric / Minecraft **1.21.11** port of [Zbx1425/minopp](https://github.com/zbx1425/minopp) ("Mino++", play UNO in Minecraft). Distributed under the original MIT license.

## Install

Drop these into your `mods/` folder:

- `minopp-1.4.0-1.21.11.jar` (below)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) (Yet Another Config Lib)

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.11 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Java 21. Install on both client and server for multiplayer.

## Notes

This is a faithful, single-version fork of the original mod, not a behavioral rewrite. A couple of behaviors deviate from upstream by deliberate decision (NBT serialization, action-bar feedback) — see [PORTING.md](https://github.com/Truhf0414/minopp-fabric-1.21.11/blob/main/PORTING.md) for details and known trade-offs.

Original mod by **zbx1425**, MIT licensed.
